p5_obj_1.SP: The white cloud drifts across the sky.
p5_obj_1.PC: The white cloud is drifting across the sky.
p5_obj_1.PA: The white cloud drifted over the hill.
p5_obj_1.PX: The white cloud was drifting over the village when the balloon rose.
p5_obj_1.PP: The white cloud has moved behind the hill.
p5_obj_1.GO: The white cloud is going to cover the sun.
p5_obj_1.WI: The white cloud will disappear by the afternoon.

p5_obj_3.PC: The bundle of wooden beams is lying on the truck.
p5_obj_3.PA: The builders tied the wooden beams together.
p5_obj_3.PX: The bundle of beams was bouncing on the truck on the bumpy road.
p5_obj_3.PP: The truck has brought the beams from the timber yard.
p5_obj_3.GO: The crane is going to lift the beams onto the house.
p5_obj_3.WI: The beams will become part of the new roof.

p5_obj_18.SP: The tall yellow crane lifts heavy things on the building site.
p5_obj_18.PC: The tall yellow crane is lifting timber over the house.
p5_obj_18.PA: The tall yellow crane lifted the timber over the house.
p5_obj_18.PX: The tall yellow crane was lifting timber when the balloon floated past.
p5_obj_18.PP: The crane has lifted all the roof beams today.
p5_obj_18.GO: The crane is going to lift the roof tiles next.
p5_obj_18.WI: The crane will leave when the house is finished.

p5_obj_24.SP: The blue wooden house stands on a quiet street.

p5_obj_26.PC: The mounted light is lighting the hallway.

p5_obj_31.SP: The rafters hold up the roof.
p5_obj_31.PC: The wooden roof rafters are holding up the roof.
p5_obj_31.PA: The carpenters fixed the rafters in place.
p5_obj_31.PX: The rafters were standing bare before the tiles went on.
p5_obj_31.PP: The workers have put insulation between the rafters.
p5_obj_31.GO: The roofers are going to cover the rafters with tiles.
p5_obj_31.WI: The rafters will hold the roof for many years.

p5_obj_33.SP: The workmen stand on the table to reach the roof.
p5_obj_33.PC: The two workmen are standing on the table.
p5_obj_33.PA: The two workmen climbed onto the table.
p5_obj_33.PX: The two workmen were standing on the table when the hose started.
p5_obj_33.PP: The workmen have used the table as a platform all day.
p5_obj_33.GO: The workmen are going to climb down from the table.
p5_obj_33.WI: The table will need a good clean after this.

p5_obj_60.SP: The house with the red roof stands on the hill.
p5_obj_60.PC: The house with the red roof is standing on the hill.
p5_obj_60.PA: Builders built the house with the red roof many years ago.
p5_obj_60.PX: The house with the red roof was shining in the sun.
p5_obj_60.PP: A family has lived in the house for many years.
p5_obj_60.GO: The family is going to watch the balloon from the window.
p5_obj_60.WI: The house with the red roof will look lovely at sunset.

labels: Builder singing into a broom like a microphone
p5_obj_64.SP: The builder often sings when a good song comes on the radio.
p5_obj_64.PA: The builder grabbed the broom and started to sing.
p5_obj_64.PX: The builder was sweeping the yard when he started to sing into the broom.
p5_obj_64.PP: The builder has only swept half the yard.
p5_obj_64.GO: The builder is going to finish his song first.
p5_obj_64.WI: The builder will feel silly if someone turns around.

p5_obj_70.SP: The garden bushes grow along the fence.
p5_obj_70.PC: The garden bushes are growing along the fence.
p5_obj_70.PA: Someone planted the garden bushes last year.
p5_obj_70.PX: The garden bushes were growing well in the sun.
p5_obj_70.PP: The garden bushes have grown thick and green.
p5_obj_70.GO: The gardener is going to cut the bushes.
p5_obj_70.WI: The garden bushes will have flowers in the summer.

p5_obj_80.PC: The wooden playhouse is standing in the garden.
p5_obj_80.WI: The wooden playhouse will be full of children at the weekend.

p5_obj_97.SP: The worker stands on the stepladder to reach the wall.
p5_obj_97.PC: The kitchen stepladder is standing by the wall.
p5_obj_97.PA: The worker carried the stepladder into the kitchen.
p5_obj_97.PX: The stepladder was wobbling a little when the man climbed it.
p5_obj_97.PP: The man has used the stepladder all morning.
p5_obj_97.GO: The man is going to fold up the stepladder.
p5_obj_97.WI: The stepladder will go back in the van tonight.

labels: Woman being splashed with paint from above
p5_obj_105.SP: The woman doesn't look up when she walks.
p5_obj_105.PA: The woman looked up just as the paint tin tipped.
p5_obj_105.PX: The woman was walking underneath when the painter's tin tipped over.
p5_obj_105.PP: The woman has got paint in her hair.
p5_obj_105.GO: The woman is going to need a long shower.
p5_obj_105.WI: The woman will laugh about it later.

p5_obj_174.SP: The builders take sand from the pile.
p5_obj_174.PC: The pile of sand is sitting next to the wall.
p5_obj_174.PA: The truck dropped the sand next to the wall.
p5_obj_174.PX: The pile of sand was getting smaller as the builders worked.
p5_obj_174.PP: The builders have used half of the sand.
p5_obj_174.GO: The builders are going to mix the sand with cement.
p5_obj_174.WI: The pile of sand will be gone by Friday.

p5_obj_181.SP: The boy holds his mother's hand on the street.
p5_obj_181.PC: The boy is holding his mother's hand.
p5_obj_181.PA: The boy held his mother's hand.
p5_obj_181.PX: The boy was holding his mother's hand when they passed the digger.
p5_obj_181.PP: The boy has held her hand all the way.
p5_obj_181.GO: The boy is going to cross the road with his mother.
p5_obj_181.WI: The boy will wave at the excavator driver.
